warrant: This check grades the numerical quantities named in output-contract.json on the independently materialized official operands. skimage.feature.haar_like_feature (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/feature/haar.py:86): local gradients, scale-space filtering and peak or descriptor decisions determine the feature measurements; coordinates and associated attributes use one correspondence, and fixed descriptor bits and sample indices remain exact; skimage.transform.integral_image (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/transform/integral.py:4): stored geometry, sampling grids, interpolation order and boundary conventions define the transform; reordered sums and interpolation arithmetic may change low bits while shifted pixels or altered projection geometry change the output. The named precision bounds retain exact discrete results and allow small floating rounding changes; a resolved one-percent gain error, a changed integer count or a changed physical region is not treated as numerical noise. The perturbation reaches only materialized call 5 (skimage.feature.haar_like_feature); its CLI-recorded spread is sensitivity evidence for that workload, not a floor for every other call. No alternative-build or accelerator floor is claimed. The source-linked bounds remain proposals until the human reviews the measured calibration and accepts their scientific scope.
